summary: Iteration 9 - Form Templates Feature Testing Complete. All 21 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified working correctly. Templates can be listed, saved, activated, duplicated, and deleted.

issues: Color contrast issue: White text on teal background (#0d9488) has contrast ratio of 3.74 (expected 4.5:1)

seed_data_creation: Test templates created during testing were cleaned up. Form config reset to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Form Templates feature fully tested and working. Backend APIs: GET /api/admin/form-config/templates (list all), POST /api/admin/form-config/templates (save current config as template), POST /api/admin/form-config/templates/{id}/activate (apply template), POST /api/admin/form-config/templates/{id}/duplicate (copy template), DELETE /api/admin/form-config/templates/{id} (delete custom only). System templates: Crédito Habitação (26 fields), Refinanciamento (26 fields with step 3 replaced), Crédito Pessoal (23 fields, no step 3 imóvel). Frontend: FormManagementPage has Templates and Guardar como Template buttons, Templates dialog shows system templates with blue Sistema badge, each template has Ativar/Duplicar buttons, custom templates also have Delete button. Activating Refinanciamento template replaces Step 3 fields with refinancing-specific fields (valor_transferencia, prazo_pretendido, banco_atual, spread_atual).
